  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "eb9291e8",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Medical Operations Dashboard\n",
    "\n",
    "# Project Overview\n",
    "The Medical Operations Dashboard is a healthcare analytics project designed to analyse hospital operational data. The objective is to transform raw hospital records into meaningful insights using Python and Power BI. The dashboard helps understand patient flow, hospital performance, waiting time, treatment outcomes, and department-wise analysis for better decision-making.\n",
    "\n",
    "# Project Objective\n",
    "\n",
    "- Analyse hospital operational data.\n",
    "- Identify patient admission trends.\n",
    "- Monitor department performance.\n",
    "- Analyse treatment outcomes.\n",
    "- Track patient waiting time.\n",
    "- Visualise state-wise patient distribution.\n",
    "- Build an interactive Power BI dashboard."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2892f4fb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Dataset Information\n",
    "\n",
    "The dataset contains approximately 1_Lakh patient records with the following information:\n",
    "\n",
    "- Patient ID\n",
    "- Age\n",
    "- Gender\n",
    "- Patient Location\n",
    "- Department Patient\n",
    "- Diagnosis\n",
    "- Severity Level\n",
    "- Admission Time\n",
    "- Discharge Time\n",
    "- Length of Stay Days\n",
    "- Wait Time in Minutes\n",
    "- Doctor ID\n",
    "- Insurance Type\n",
    "- Treatment Cost USD\n",
    "- Readmission Flag\n",
    "- Outcome\n",
    "- Doctor Name\n",
    "- Department Doctor\n",
    "- Hospital ID\n",
    "- Hospital Name\n",
    "- Branch\n",
    "- City\n",
    "- State\n",
    "- Hospital Type\n",
    "- Total Beds\n",
    "- Latitude\n",
    "- Longitude\n",
    "- Nurse ID\n",
    "- Nurse Name\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5d40ef66",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Data Collection\n",
    "\n",
    "The dataset was collected from an open-source healthcare dataset and modified for educational purposes to support dashboard creation.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "149d63ec",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Data Cleaning\n",
    "\n",
    "The following preprocessing steps were performed using Excel:\n",
    "\n",
    "- Loaded the CSV dataset.\n",
    "- Checked missing values.\n",
    "- Checked duplicate records.\n",
    "- Removed duplicate rows (if found).\n",
    "- Verified data types.\n",
    "- Renamed columns for consistency.\n",
    "- Checked invalid or unnecessary values.\n",
    "- Prepared clean data for analysis."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7a57f8d6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Feature Engineering\n",
    "\n",
    "Some additional columns were created to improve dashboard analysis.\n",
    "- Doctor Name\n",
    "- Department Doctor\n",
    "- Hospital ID\n",
    "- Hospital Name\n",
    "- Branch\n",
    "- City\n",
    "- State\n",
    "- Hospital Type\n",
    "- Total Beds\n",
    "- Latitude\n",
    "- Longitude\n",
    "- Nurse ID\n",
    "- Nurse Name\n"
   ]
  },
